Name: Orchard - Better Fruit Trees
Author: saitoue
Description:
[center][size=4]﻿Orchard - Better Fruit Trees[/size][/center]

Features

[list]
[*]Fruit trees can now be fertilized increasing their growth speed
[*]Fertilized fully grown fruit trees will grow one additional fruit while in season
[*]Fertilized fully grown fruit trees will grow fruit normally while out of season (except in winter)
[*](Fully grown Trees need to be refertilized every season)
[*]Fruit trees have a chance to grow an additional fruit each day based on the players foraging level
[*]Fruit trees have a chance to drop their respective sapling when fruits are shaken of them (one per season)
[*]Bee houses in range of fully grown trees will cause the tree to reach higher quality faster
[*]Shaking fruit of Trees will now grant foraging exp to the player
[/list]
Configuration
[list]
[*]Some features a now able to be turned on or of
[*]Out of game Options via config.json file in the mod folder
[*]In game Options  via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Options Menu[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][/url]
﻿[/list]Installation

[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Unpack folder into your mods folder﻿ 
[*]Installing or uninstalling while using an existing save should not be  a problem
[/list]
Special Thanks

[/list]
